title: One game, one drive
note: The 212GB figure comes off store listings and size trackers; 210GB is the more widely repeated number. Rockstar has published neither. Usable-capacity figures are community measurements, not Sony specifications.

title: The physical edition
note: Reported by ResetEra users with PEGI-region copies and written up by GameSpot. North American copies obscure the code. GTA 6 ships code-in-box with no disc.

title: One drive, two jobs
right: What E-Day wants from the same SSD
rows: A few GB held as a memory tier
Paged out and back every frame
note: The Coalition reserves part of the Series S SSD as a slower RAM tier, worth roughly 1GB against an 8GB budget. Tom's Hardware measured the PC equivalent streaming at up to 3.7 GB/s.

title: Where the size pass lands
note: The request never comes out of scope — nobody removes a district six weeks from ship. It comes out of surfaces, as a batch job with an exceptions list.

title: What the analysts expect
note: BMO forecasts 55 million units in Take-Two's fiscal 2027; Raymond James puts the blended average selling price near $90. Both are analyst estimates, not company guidance.

text: Shelf space moved inside the machine, where nobody can see how full it is.
